title: Relabeling symbols in a configuration
statement: Given an alphabet bijection $e$ and a configuration for a fixed input, define the relabeled configuration by applying $e$ to every symbol stored on every work tape, leaving blank cells unchanged. The state, head positions, input, and output are preserved.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration for a fixed input and a machine with $k$ work tapes
